description: This file defines a utility class 'Log' that wraps around Android's native logging system. It provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT), maintains a linked list of LogNodes for chaining log actions, and serves as a helper for logging in Android applications.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that provides static methods for logging messages and managing a chain of LogNodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which logs are sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends log data to the LogNode chain for output.
